Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path and stakeholders.

Recap from discovery
- Primary use: inference for transactional analytics (low-latency, high-throughput) across US regions.
- Expected initial footprint: 3 dedicated GPUs, then scale to ~10 in 3–6 months.
- Decision criteria: latency (<150ms p50), predictable unit cost, SOC2+ evidence, and a standard PO-based billing flow.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: you (Sanjay Patel) — confirmed.
- Procurement / invoicing: Laura Simmons (cc if/when helpful) + purchasing@finrx.com.
- Security/legal: Laura will route to internal counsel; asked for SOC2 report and data-flow diagram.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I attached a short vendor readiness questionnaire to help your procurement team map technical and billing requirements (vendor_questionnaire.pdf). Please share with Laura / purchasing.
2) Can you confirm: who will raise the PO and the typical lead time once legal signs off? You mentioned a 2–4 week window, but want confirmation.
3) Tentative timeline: we aim to have onboarding + first validation workload within 3 weeks of PO execution. If your procurement needs more time, we’ll plan accordingly.

Proposed meeting: 30-min procurement + finance sync next week to walk through invoice flow and PO template. I’ll send a few slots once you confirm attendees.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.pdf (filled by us for initial context), redwood_initial_quote_v1.pdf

Thanks — looping Ben and Marcus to support legal/security questions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

Answers to your asks
- Procurement contact: Laura Simmons (cc'd). She is our vendor intake owner and will manage PO/invoice routing.
- Typical PO timing: after vendor acceptance & legal review, expect 2–4 weeks for standard vendors. For anything requiring a custom SOW or special SLA, add another 1–2 weeks.
- Who raises the PO: Normally our finance team creates the PO once legal confirms contract language; vendor must be in our vendor registry first.

Security/legal checkpoints
- SOC 2: must have a current SOC 2 Type II report; can you share the report or a redacted summary?
- Data residency: production data must remain in US regions. Are you able to confirm region pinning and contract language to that effect?

Procurement form
- Attached is our standard procurement intake (finrx_procurement_form.xlsx). I filled the sections I can and left procurement/legal sections blank for your team to complete.

Timeline note
- We have a budgeting window that closes Sep 10; ideally we have a signed PO by early Sep to hit the Q3 commit budget. If there are blockers, please flag them and we can escalate.

Happy to take a short call with Laura + purchasing to walk through the form.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Director of ML Platforms | FinRx
